slides.title: A concept convinces a room.
slides.sub: A product has to convince a user, an auditor and a risk team. Case 07: an AI hedging product.

slides.html:
The case
From concept to deployment.
Context
UX and product strategy at lpa for digital product advisory in banking.
My part
HedgePilot, an AI-supported hedging product. I stayed with it from concept to deployment.

slides.title: What deployment asks
items: Can the user explain the decision the AI supported?
Does every step pass compliance without a workaround?
Who owns the outcome when the model is wrong?
slides.punch: A concept never has to answer these.

slides.text: If the concept has no answer, deployment will find one. Late.

slides.title: Ask the deployment questions in the first concept workshop.
slides.sub: In banking, health and energy, strategy is tested where the product meets the people who carry the risk.
slides.sign: I design products that cannot afford to fail.
